cases.equipment: Physical keyboard and signed installed Windows candidate
cases.steps: Complete onboarding, open a community invitation, navigate rooms and direct messages, send a message, use menus and dialogs, and sign out without a pointing device.
cases.expected: Every action is reachable in a logical order, visible focus never disappears, Escape closes transient UI, and focus returns to the initiating control.

cases.equipment: Current NVDA, speakers or headphones, and signed installed Windows candidate
cases.steps: Read onboarding, invitation review, room navigation, message timeline, composer, message actions, notifications, recovery, and voice controls with browse and focus modes.
cases.expected: Landmarks, names, roles, states, message order, live updates, errors, and recovery actions are announced once and in context.

cases.equipment: Windows display scaling or text size at 200 percent and signed installed candidate
cases.steps: Repeat onboarding, invitation, room, direct-message, settings, recovery, and voice-control journeys at 1280 by 720 logical desktop space.
cases.expected: No required control or text is clipped, overlapped, hidden without a reachable scroll path, or dependent on horizontal page scrolling.

cases.equipment: Windows contrast theme and signed installed candidate
cases.steps: Inspect onboarding, room navigation, unread state, composer, focus, errors, dialogs, recovery, and voice states with a Windows contrast theme enabled.
cases.expected: Text, boundaries, selected state, focus, status, and disabled state remain distinguishable without color-only meaning.

cases.equipment: Windows animation effects disabled and signed installed candidate
cases.steps: Open and close navigation, settings, dialogs, drawers, onboarding transitions, message actions, and voice controls.
cases.expected: Nonessential motion is removed immediately while state changes, focus movement, and progress remain understandable.
